description_ru: Современное звено. Аллювиальные отложения пойменных террас. Суглинки, пески, супеси, редко глины
note: GGK-200 O-44-XXV (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR 1:200 000, West Siberian series, map of Quaternary formations; PGO Novosibirskgeologiya, author V.E. Markeev, ed. V.A. Martynov; approved 1989, printed 2000; 78-79E 56d40m-57d20mN, Vasyugan plain). RASTER = geokniga 1935x2379 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px); tints calibrated on the map (preview_tint_calib.py), floodplain / terrace / edIII tints sampled on the map; lakes = WATER (pale tint pinned). The cyan plain is the Fedosovo-suite lake deposits LI-IIfd under COVER symbols: lake-bog peat (LbIV/LI-IIfd, green T marks) and eluvial-deluvial loams / clays (edIII/LI-IIfd); the symbol-density test (prep_overprint, green T glyphs) did not delineate the bogs (glyph regions followed the green boundary lines), so the covers are not separated: one class LI-IIfd, hclass L (the colour of the map), hclass2 O (peat cover over much of it); the mapped LbIV tint is not distinct from the cyan plain and PREQ (only on sections) is absent from the face. Frame = 4 corners on the inner edge of the neatline + 7 interior 15x10 min graticule crossings + 11 graticule-at-frame ties (3 ties dropped by the leave-one-out screen) (r200i)
